name: knirvtestnet
description: KNIRV Testnet - Unified Web Portal and API Gateway for the KNIRV Decentralized Trusted Execution Network
readme: Available Scripts: npm start (full testnet), npm run dev:parallel (development mode), npm run testnet:status (check status), npm run testnet:stop (stop all), npm run logs (view logs)

scripts.dev: npm run build:all && npm run testnet:start
scripts.dev:parallel: npm run install:deps && concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue" "npm run server:dev" "npm run health:dev"
scripts.testnet:restart: npm run testnet:stop && npm run testnet:start
scripts.podman:restart: npm run podman:stop && npm run podman:start
scripts.build: npm run install:deps && npm run build:all
scripts.build:all: npm run build:nexus && npm run build:graphchain && npm run build:agent-portal
scripts.build:graphchain: npm run load-endpoints:testnet && echo 'GraphChain Explorer built for Render'
scripts.build:agent-portal: echo 'Agent Developer Portal built for Render'
scripts.lint: echo 'Linting not configured - add ESLint for production'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json data/knirvnexus/portal/node_modules /data/knirvnexus/portal/package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm cache clean --force && npm install
scripts.health-report: npm run check-health && npm run check-nexus-health
